title: Shopper Support Desk Guidance — Mileage Adjustments on Cartwise Shopper Batches
content:
The desk answers a shopper's submitted mileage dispute on a completed batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches, finalized or not, by booking one pay adjustment with the reason mileage underpaid that carries that dispute's reference, and the dispute is marked approved.

A mileage adjustment is not booked until the batch carries a submitted mileage dispute from the shopper stating a claimed amount.

## The answer at a glance

| Point | Rule |
|---|---|
| What is answered | The shopper's submitted mileage dispute on a completed batch, whether or not the batch's pay has been finalized |
| What is booked | One pay adjustment, reason mileage underpaid, carrying that dispute's reference |
| Effect on the dispute | It is marked approved |
| What must already stand on the batch | A submitted mileage dispute from the shopper stating a claimed amount |

## Situation of use and capability of `book_mileage_adjustment_6fe9f3bb`

`book_mileage_adjustment_6fe9f3bb` approves a shopper's mileage dispute on a completed batch by crediting a mileage pay adjustment. One call books a single pay adjustment on the named batch with the reason given, today's date and the dispute it answers, marks that dispute approved, and raises the batch's earnings by the amount credited; the adjustment and the approved dispute are visible to the shopper at once.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `book_mileage_adjustment_6fe9f3bb` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `batch_id` | The batch number of the shopper batch the adjustment is credited to, as returned by the batch lookup for the verified shopper | Id |
| `shopper_account_id` | The shopper contractor account number the adjustment counts against, as returned by the shopper-account lookup and shown on the batch | Id |
| `batch_pay_dispute_id` | The reference number of the shopper's mileage dispute the adjustment answers, as returned when the dispute was filed or by the pay-dispute lookup | Id |
| `adjustment_reason` | The controlled reason of the adjustment | Enum, exactly one value from the list below |
| `amount_usd` | The amount credited, in USD | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent by the caller; stored rounded to 2 decimal places |

Values of `adjustment_reason`:

- `shown_pay_shortfall` — pay before tips fell short of the pay shown on the accepted offer
- `mileage_underpaid` — mileage pay fell short of the miles driven beyond the tolerance
- `heavy_pay_missing` — heavy pay was owed and not paid
- `wait_pay_missing` — waiting-time pay was owed and not paid
- `boost_missing` — the boost shown on the offer was owed and not paid
- `cancellation_pay_missing` — pay owed for a batch canceled after shopping started was not paid
- `return_pay_missing` — pay for an order returned to the store was owed and not paid

## Return

A text receipt of a dictionary carrying `batch_event_id` (the reference number of the adjustment entry), `batch_id`, `adjustment_reason`, `batch_pay_dispute_id` (the dispute answered), `dispute_status` (always approved), `amount_usd` (USD, 2 decimal places), `event_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `batch_earnings_usd` (the batch's earnings once the credit is booked). Receiving the `batch_event_id` means the adjustment is booked and the dispute approved.
